component.name: HouseMD
component.summary: A quiet, local-first Markdown and LaTeX workspace

description.p: HouseMD is a local-first Markdown and LaTeX editor with live preview, CodeMirror editing, line numbers, tabs, session recovery, and a folder sidebar.
Markdown previews support KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, sanitized README HTML, tables, task lists, and local images. LaTeX documents can be compiled to PDF with a host TeX Live installation.
